newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel proposes Jordan supply Palestinians cement.
newsitem.headline: Israel proposes Jordan supply Palestinians cement.

text.p: Israel proposed on Thursday letting Jordan sell cement directly to the Palestinian Authority in the West Bank.

"One of the most important goods for Jordan to sell the Palestinians is cement. Their cement industry is very well developed. The Palestinians need a lot of cement," Industry and Trade Minister Natan Sharansky told Israel Radio.
"And we proposed to them today to get around security problems to build a pipeline north of Jericho of the sort we already have between us and the Palestinian Authority next to Gaza," he said.
Sharansky said the Palestinians, embroiled in a peacemaking crisis with Israel, had for several months refused to enter into negotiations on the issue.

Israel Radio said that Israel -- which has handed over parts of the Gaza Strip and West Bank to Yasser Arafat's Palestinian Authority since the launch of Israeli-PLO peace moves in 1993 -- would help finance the operation.
